UC Berkeley · Asilomar 2026

Open-vocabulary results, voiced EMG

Harvard sentences reconstructed from voiced EMG, with word error rate shown per sentence.

These are voiced-EMG reconstructions, not silent synthesis. The main demo is silent EMG on a closed vocabulary. Open-vocabulary silent synthesis is what we’re working towards.

Every clip is a held-out test utterance. The badges say whether the sentence was new as well: “unseen sentence” means the text never appeared in training at all; “seen sentence” means the text did appear, in other recording sessions.

♫Best with headphones.

Ground truth is the speaker’s recording; the other two are model output from voiced EMG. ← Back to the main demo
